fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on Florida state government and the legislature, including criticism of Governor Sholtz’s proposed sales tax and discussion of the “Florida Recovery Act” aimed at restricting chain stores. Local civic and political coverage includes the Miami municipal election and candidates for city commission, along with commentary on public affairs and proposals such as a Pan-American exposition. Regular columns and features cover social notes and nightlife, sports talk, and extensive horse-racing tipster advertising and selections; the issue also contains local business promotions and merchant listings.
